lightIdle: Kwala aterese epe ya webosaete. Re tlhatlhoba lenaane la rona la ditshosetso, sebopego, go eka merka, DNS le karabo ya jaanong. Mo Ema: tswa, netefatsa ka kanaleng ya semmuso e o setseng o e tshepile, mme o begele fa o rata.
lightLimited: E phepa e raya gore diteko tse di dirilweng ga di a naya tsiboso e e maatla — ga se tsholofetso ya gore saete e sireletsegile.
privacyNote: Ka tlwaelo: ga go bolokwe sepe. Teko ya diphoso e thusa go baakanya mathata a sethekeniki fela — le ka mohla e se aterese, gape le ka mohla e se go phasaladiwa.
privacyOff: O se ka wa boloka le ka mohla
noClaim: Ga go na mokgatlho o o tlhophilweng
privacy: Teko eno e sala mo khomphuteng eno. Ga go bolokwe hisitori ya go praosa.
invalid: Tsenya aterese ya HTTP kgotsa HTTPS e e siameng.
limits: Se teko eno e sa se itseng
actions: Kgato ya tshireletso e e atlenegisitsweng
ignoreRiskBody: O ka naya diphasewete, dintlha tsa tuelo, kgotsa datha e nngwe ya motho mo yo o laolang aterese eno. Tswalela thebe pele o kwala kgotsa o duelela sepe.
nextStepsTitle: Se o tshwanetseng go se dira morago — kgato ka kgato
nextStepLeave: Tswa mo tsebeng eno jaanong — o se ka wa tswelela mo atereseng e o e tlhatlhobileng.
nextStepNoCredentials: O se ka wa tsenya diphasewete, dinomoro tsa dikarata, dikhoutu tsa SMS/imeile, kgotsa datha e nngwe ya motho mo saeteng eno.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Netefatsa ka go ikemela: bula domain kgotsa app ya semmuso ya mokgatlho o o setseng o o tshepile (bukemaka, karata ya banka, lebenkele la di-app le le itsiweng). O se ka wa dirisa megala kgotsa di-imeile tse di bontshitsweng mo tsebeng e e belaelwang.
nextStepReport: Ka kgetho: boloka fa tlase mokwalo wa pego ya selegae gore modiri a tlhatlhobe host bakeng sa lenaane la ditshosetso le le tlhokomelwang.
nextStepBlock: Ka kgetho: thibela host mo katoloso kgotsa app ya teseke ya buusdo gore e nne thata go e bula ka phoso.
nextStepLooksReal: Ditsebe tsa tsietso gantsi di lebega di tlhokisisitswe mme di dirisa HTTPS. Boleng jwa pono ga bo tlhomamise gore saete e siame.
honestLimitsTitle: Mellwane e e ikanyegang ya sediriswa seno
honestLimitNoWipe: buusdo ga e kgone go phimola tshedimosetso ya motho e webosaete e setseng e e kgobokeditse. Fetola diphasewete mo saeteng ya nnete ya semmuso fa o tsentse sepe, mme o lebelele ditsiboso tsa banka/imeile.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Dipholo di tswa mo lenaaneng le le tlhokomelwang le matshwao a aterese a buusdo — e seng palo ya setšhaba ya gore ke batho ba bakae ba begele saete.
honestLimitNoAv: Seno ga se sehlahiswa sa antivirus. Go tswalela thebe go emisa go tsenya datha fano; ga e sikeine kgotsa e phepafatse sediriswa sa gago.
feedbackFalsePositive: Folaga e e fosagetseng — mokwalo wa tshwao e e fosagetseng
feedbackEmpty: Ga go ise go nne le mekwalo ya dikakgelo.
feedbackDraftsAfterReport: Morago ga mokwalo wa pego ya Ema: tshwaya lenaane fa tlase, romela kwa ntle batches/*.json, mme modiri a tsamaisa npm run threat:apply. Ga go romelwe sepe go tswa mo sebatling seno.
